introduction.name: MUHAR FERDIANSYAH
introduction.headline: I make existing software work better.
introduction.availability: Open to remote roles & freelance projects · Jakarta (UTC+7)
introduction.supporting: Full Stack Engineer (Next.js, Laravel, Flutter). I untangle, speed up, and extend production software.
introduction.description: Most software does not need a rewrite. It needs simpler architecture, targeted optimization, and room to grow. I work with existing systems to keep them reliable and useful to the business around them.
introduction.closing: Curious about how things work. Focused on making them work better.

thinking.headline: I don't start with the stack. I start with the problem.

principles.title: UNDERSTAND
principles.description: Find what is actually getting in the way. I look at how the software behaves today, the real constraints around it, and how people actually use it before reaching for tools.

principles.title: SIMPLIFY
principles.description: Remove unnecessary complexity before adding more. I untangle architecture and strip away excess layers. Simple problems should never be solved with complicated systems.

principles.title: EVOLVE
principles.description: Improve what exists without rebuilding blindly. I optimize bottlenecks and refine the architecture step by step, keeping the system stable and ready to grow as needs change.
